Attempt 04 CLI test incorrectly expected raw diagnostic prose in the compact text formatter; changed assertion to its documented bounded_truncation status.

Attempt 07 focused output/query/CLI/MCP checks pass; attempt 08 records the final unchanged-source validation and repository capture.
